searchText: https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Beacon/getBlockHeaders includes the `finalized` metadata field, but it doesn't make much sense to me. What would determine the value? Maybe `true` means "all headers come from finalized blocks"? i'm not sure how this endpoint is supposed to return more than 1 header and if we only have 1 header, then the field simply tells you if your node sees that block (header) as finalized or not
